entries.text:
Task: harden how toolreader displays Codex sessions, testing against the real Codex CLI sessions on this machine. Report back what you found and fixed.

Context: toolreader (this repo, read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly, including "The ways to hurt yourself") is a read-only viewer of what coding agents did. It already lists and renders Codex sessions that ran outside T3 through `codex app-server` (src/server/CodexSessions.ts, src/core/codex.ts, src/core/normalize.ts). There are ~2600 Codex rollout files under <path>

Branch: you are on `feat/production-plan`. Create `fix/codex-display` from it and commit there. Do not touch master or push anything.

What to do:
1. Pick ~15 diverse real Codex sessions (interactive CLI, `codex exec`, long ones, ones with apply_patch / file edits, MCP tool calls, web search, failed commands, subagents, images, very large outputs, old and new rollout formats). For each, compare what the viewer shows (API `/api/threads/<id>` and the UI) against the raw rollout JSONL. Look for: missing or duplicated actions, wrong kinds/colors, wrong status (failed shown as ok), broken diffs, wrong timestamps/order, unreadable titles, items that degrade to untyped rows, crashes, slow loads.
2. Fix what is wrong, at the root cause, each with a focused unit test using a trimmed, anonymized payload (no real secrets or private paths in fixtures).
3. Known bug to fix too: shell commands quoted like '"'…'"' are parsed wrongly in src/core/shell.ts.
4. Run the server on PORT=4779 (never 4777) against a snapshot of the T3 DB as AGENTS.md "Test data" describes. Use the T3 preview browser tools to check the UI for the sessions you fixed. Stop only the server PID you started.
5. Verify: `vp test run`, `vp check`, `vp run typecheck`, `vp run build`. Commit in small conventional commits (git -c user.email=<private> commit), each ending with the line: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Report: a table of sessions checked (id prefix, kind, what was wrong), the commits you made, and anything you found but did not fix.

The user explicitly asked for T3 preview browser tools in step 4, so I'm authorized to proceed there. Since the server serves the dist folder, I need to build first and then restart the server before checking the UI.
Now the UI check (you asked for the T3 preview tools, so I'm going ahead). Rebuild and restart on 4779:

entries.text:
I'm puzzling over the diff header claiming two old lines when the patch body seems to only have one real line plus a trailing empty line, which might be getting miscounted as shared context.

I think the fix is to trim trailing empty lines per file in parsePatch, and map any leftover empty-string lines to context lines when numbering hunks, since some models omit the leading space for context lines. I should also verify unified diff stats aren't affected and add a test case for a patch with a trailing empty line.
Bug: the hunk header says 2 lines but there's only one `-`/`+` pair; a trailing blank line from the patch gets counted as context, and a bare empty line isn't valid unified-diff context. Test first:

entries.text: The diff looks right with proper -1/+1 markers and no line numbers, and the failed type-check correctly shows exit 2. I'll commit the blank-line fix now.
The recovered patch renders as a proper `+1 −1` diff without line numbers, and failed commands show their exit codes. Commit the blank-line fix:

entries.title: vp check --fix 2>&1 · git add src/core/normalize.ts src/core/rollout.test.ts · git commit -q -F - <<EOF 2>&1 · git log --oneline -1
entries.command:
cd . && export PATH=$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH && vp check --fix 2>&1 | grep -E "error|warn" ; git add src/core/normalize.ts src/core/rollout.test.ts && git -c user.email=<private> commit -q -F - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|fail"; git log --oneline -1
fix(normalize): blank lines in apply_patch hunks no longer skew the diff

A trailing blank line was counted as context, so the header claimed more
lines than the hunk had; an inner blank line is not valid unified-diff
context. Drop trailing ones and turn inner ones into blank context.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
